principle: select an existing authored head only when a narrow safety rule dominates every competing lifecycle branch

safe_rules.rationale: a party-authorized cancellation before any shipment evidence is the least irreversible outcome
an authored dispute halts ordinary lifecycle progression without deciding the underlying merits

invariants: the canonical revision is an existing authored transaction head
all immutable transaction identity fields match across heads
every raw head remains visible in the resolution evidence
superseded heads are listed explicitly and never deleted
timestamps and action-hash ordering never decide a material conflict
unsafe conflicts expose no canonical revision and reject mutations
the policy does not decide fault, compensation, settlement, or reputation
unsafe conflicts may become authorized_resolved only through immutable bilateral or arbitration authority
authorized projections select an existing authored branch and preserve all original heads
a later fork of the selected branch becomes a fresh conflict
claims_not_established: semantic merge of arbitrary transaction metadata
